```{r setup_models, fig.width=14, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ======================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD LIBRARIES & DATA CLEANING
# ======================================================================
library(haven)    
library(dplyr)    
library(rms)      
library(pROC)     # ĐÃ BỔ SUNG: Thư viện bắt buộc để tính toán và vẽ ROC
library(ggplot2)

# Read dataset (Note: Use local path for knitting, or mock data for GitHub)
data_goc <- read_sav("D:/NghienCuu/Nghiencuu.sav")

# Recode value 2 to 0, strip SPSS labels, and AUTOMATICALLY DICHOTOMIZE CONTINUOUS VARIABLES
data_clean <- data_goc %>%
  mutate(
    GPB          = as.numeric(ifelse(GPB == 2, 0, GPB)), 
    
    nguongtuoi   = as.numeric(ifelse(nguongtuoi == 2, 0, nguongtuoi)),
    Soitrong     = as.numeric(ifelse(Soitrong == 2, 0, Soitrong)),
    nguongtnm    = as.numeric(ifelse(nguongtnm == 2, 0, nguongtnm)),
    Khitrong     = as.numeric(ifelse(Khitrong == 2, 0, Khitrong)),
    hachviem     = as.numeric(ifelse(hachviem == 2, 0, hachviem)),
    dichtudo     = as.numeric(ifelse(dichtudo == 2, 0, dichtudo)),
    dichkhutru   = as.numeric(ifelse(dichkhutru == 2, 0, dichkhutru)),
    nguongAIR    = as.numeric(ifelse(nguongAIR == 2, 0, nguongAIR)),
    
    nguongdkrt   = as.numeric(ifelse(dkruotthua > 11.5, 1, 0)),
    nguongmt     = as.numeric(ifelse(dmanhtrang > 7.2, 1, 0)) 
  )

# =====================================================================
# STEP 2 & 3: SET UP ENVIRONMENT & INITIALIZE MODELS
# =====================================================================
dd <- datadist(data_clean)
options(datadist="dd")

fit_air <- lrm(GPB ~ AIR, data = data_clean, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
fit_ct <- lrm(GPB ~ dichkhutru + nguongtnm + nguongdkrt + nguongmt, data = data_clean, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
fit_scap <- lrm(GPB ~ dichkhutru + nguongtnm + nguongdkrt + nguongmt + nguongAIR, data = data_clean, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)

# =====================================================================
# STEP 4: RUN BOOTSTRAP VALIDATION (2000 RESAMPLES)
# =====================================================================
set.seed(123) 
cal_air <- calibrate(fit_air, method = "boot", B = 2000)
cal_ct <- calibrate(fit_ct, method = "boot", B = 2000)
cal_scap <- calibrate(fit_scap, method = "boot", B = 2000)

val_air <- validate(fit_air, B = 2000)
val_ct <- validate(fit_ct, B = 2000)
val_scap <- validate(fit_scap, B = 2000)

# =====================================================================
# STEP 5: EXPORT 3 CALIBRATION PLOTS IN A SINGLE CLEAN FRAME
# =====================================================================
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2), cex.axis = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.3)

plot_cal <- function(cal_obj, label_text) {
  plot(cal_obj, 
       main = "", 
       xlab = "Predicted Probability", 
       ylab = "Observed Proportion",
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       scat1d.opts = list(frac = 0.05, lwd = 1.5), 
       subtitles = FALSE, 
       legend = FALSE) 
  
  mtext(label_text, side = 3, adj = -0.1, line = 0.5, cex = 1.5, font = 2)
  
  legend("bottomright", 
         legend = c("Ideal", "Apparent", "Bias-corrected"),
         lty = c(2, 3, 1), 
         col = c("black", "black", "black"), 
         lwd = c(1, 1, 2), 
         bty = "n", cex = 1.1)
}

plot_cal(cal_air, "(A)")
plot_cal(cal_ct, "(B)")
plot_cal(cal_scap, "(C)")

# Reset layout for next plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# =====================================================================
# STEP 6: CALCULATE AND PLOT ROC CURVES
# =====================================================================
# ĐÃ BỔ SUNG: Tính toán đối tượng ROC trước khi vẽ
roc_air <- roc(data_clean$GPB, predict(fit_air, type="fitted"))
roc_ct <- roc(data_clean$GPB, predict(fit_ct, type="fitted"))
roc_scap <- roc(data_clean$GPB, predict(fit_scap, type="fitted"))

par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2) + 0.1) 

plot(roc_scap, col = "red", lwd = 3, legacy.axes = TRUE, xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity", cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.2, main = "")                  
plot(roc_ct, col = "blue", lwd = 3, add = TRUE)                 
plot(roc_air, col = "forestgreen", lwd = 3, add = TRUE)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(paste0("SCAP Model (AUC = ", round(auc(roc_scap), 3), ")"),
                  paste0("CT Only (AUC = ", round(auc(roc_ct), 3), ")"),
                  paste0("AIR Only (AUC = ", round(auc(roc_air), 3), ")")),
       col = c("red", "blue", "forestgreen"), lwd = 3, cex = 1.1, bty = "n")                

# =====================================================================
# STEP 7: OPTIMISM-CORRECTED DECISION CURVE ANALYSIS (DCA)
# =====================================================================
calc_nb <- function(pred_prob, outcome, thresholds) {
  sapply(thresholds, function(pt) {
    tp <- sum(pred_prob >= pt & outcome == 1)
    fp <- sum(pred_prob >= pt & outcome == 0)
    n <- length(outcome)
    nb <- (tp / n) - (fp / n) * (pt / (1 - pt))
    return(nb)
  })
}

fit_air_glm <- glm(GPB ~ AIR, data = data_clean, family = binomial)
fit_ct_glm <- glm(GPB ~ dichkhutru + nguongtnm + nguongdkrt + nguongmt, data = data_clean, family = binomial)
fit_scap_glm <- glm(GPB ~ dichkhutru + nguongtnm + nguongdkrt + nguongmt + nguongAIR, data = data_clean, family = binomial)

thresholds <- seq(0, 0.9, by = 0.01)

nb_app_air <- calc_nb(predict(fit_air_glm, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)
nb_app_ct <- calc_nb(predict(fit_ct_glm, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)
nb_app_scap <- calc_nb(predict(fit_scap_glm, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)

B <- 2000 
opt_air <- matrix(0, nrow = B, ncol = length(thresholds))
opt_ct <- matrix(0, nrow = B, ncol = length(thresholds))
opt_scap <- matrix(0, nrow = B, ncol = length(thresholds))

set.seed(123) 
for(i in 1:B) {
  boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(data_clean), replace = TRUE)
  boot_data <- data_clean[boot_idx, ]
  
  boot_fit_air <- glm(formula(fit_air_glm), data = boot_data, family = binomial)
  boot_fit_ct <- glm(formula(fit_ct_glm), data = boot_data, family = binomial)
  boot_fit_scap <- glm(formula(fit_scap_glm), data = boot_data, family = binomial)
  
  nb_boot_air <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_air, type="response"), boot_data$GPB, thresholds)
  nb_boot_ct <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_ct, type="response"), boot_data$GPB, thresholds)
  nb_boot_scap <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_scap, type="response"), boot_data$GPB, thresholds)
  
  nb_test_air <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_air, newdata=data_clean, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)
  nb_test_ct <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_ct, newdata=data_clean, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)
  nb_test_scap <- calc_nb(predict(boot_fit_scap, newdata=data_clean, type="response"), data_clean$GPB, thresholds)
  
  opt_air[i, ] <- nb_boot_air - nb_test_air
  opt_ct[i, ] <- nb_boot_ct - nb_test_ct
  opt_scap[i, ] <- nb_boot_scap - nb_test_scap
}

corr_nb_air <- nb_app_air - colMeans(opt_air, na.rm=TRUE)
corr_nb_ct <- nb_app_ct - colMeans(opt_ct, na.rm=TRUE)
corr_nb_scap <- nb_app_scap - colMeans(opt_scap, na.rm=TRUE)

prev <- mean(data_clean$GPB)
nb_treat_all <- prev - (1 - prev) * (thresholds / (1 - thresholds))
nb_treat_none <- rep(0, length(thresholds))

dca_df <- data.frame(
  Threshold = rep(thresholds, 5),
  NB = c(corr_nb_scap, corr_nb_ct, corr_nb_air, nb_treat_all, nb_treat_none),
  Strategy = factor(rep(c("SCAP Model", "CT Model", "AIR Model", "Treat All", "Treat None"), 
                        each = length(thresholds)),
                    levels = c("SCAP Model", "CT Model", "AIR Model", "Treat All", "Treat None"))
)

dca_df$NB[dca_df$NB < -0.05] <- NA 

ggplot(dca_df, aes(x = Threshold, y = NB, color = Strategy, linetype = Strategy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SCAP Model" = "#C77CFF", "CT Model" = "#00BFC4", "AIR Model" = "#00BA38", "Treat All" = "#F8766D", "Treat None" = "#B79F00")) +  
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("SCAP Model" = "solid", "CT Model" = "solid", "AIR Model" = "solid", "Treat All" = "solid", "Treat None" = "solid")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Threshold Probability", y = "Net Benefit", color = "Strategy", linetype = "Strategy") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.70),                      
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.05, 0.45), xlim = c(0, 0.9))
```
